title: Package Benefit Schedule: Days Added to Larger-Class Partner Rentals under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Package days.** Package days are added to the days an accepted larger-class partner rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement is authorized for. They come from the household's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package, according to the highest rental option rank that the package allows.

| Highest rental option rank the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package allows | Package days added |
|---|---|
| 6 | 2 days |
| 4 or 5 | 1 day |
| Below 4 (0, 1, 2 or 3) | None |

## Rank reference

The ranks are those of the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement options:

| Rank | Option |
|---|---|
| 1 | 30/900 |
| 2 | 40/1200 |
| 3 | 50/1500 |
| 4 | 60/1800 |
| 5 | 75/2250 |
| 6 | 100/3000 |

The figure that decides the package days is the rank the auto package allows. It is not the rank of the option the vehicle actually carries.

## Cases (hypothetical households)

- The package allows rank 6, and the vehicle carries 50/1500. Package days: 2.
- The package allows rank 5, and the vehicle carries 75/2250. Package days: 1.
- The package allows rank 3. Package days: none.
